WorkflowCoach is NovaLearn AI's upcoming guided workflow assistant [NL-002#NL-002-S07]. Its current state is a restricted private beta: it is enabled for approximately 11% of active customers, primarily selected mid-market logistics and enterprise manufacturing clients such as Acme Manufacturing [NL-002#NL-002-S07][NL-014#NL-014-S05]. Until the official public beta, access remains limited to approved pilot accounts [NL-002#NL-002-S07]. Feedback from the private beta has highlighted the need for offline caching of step lists and automated photo verification of physical tasks [NL-014#NL-014-S05].

Officially, the public beta is targeted for September 2026, with v2.9.0 dated September 29, 2026 [NL-014#NL-014-S03][NL-014#NL-014-S05][NL-015#NL-015-S05]. That release is planned for all active Growth and Enterprise accounts, allowing admins to designate documents as "Workflow Guides" and enroll users in guided execution paths [NL-014#NL-014-S05]. However, internal sources indicate the September target may slip to November 2026 due to dependencies on the Advanced OCR Pipeline and the Okta permission synchronization engine [NL-002#NL-002-S07][NL-014#NL-014-S05]. The CTO states the September target is in serious jeopardy because of high latency during step transitions (up to 4 seconds), permission inheritance failures that could expose restricted documents to unauthorized users, and the need to avoid cutting corners on permission checks; his realistic engineering estimate is November 2026 [NL-015#NL-015-S05]. Product leadership says external messaging will stick to the official September roadmap for now, but internally the team is aligning on a November slip contingency; a September private beta is possible only for customers with flat document structures and no sensitive compliance data, not for regulated clients such as BrightPath Healthcare [NL-015#NL-015-S05].

Planned functionality includes parsing procedural documents into sequential operational blocks, guiding employees step-by-step with confirmations, verification photo uploads, or compliance questions, and recording completed steps in the tenant compliance log; skipped or failed validation steps are flagged and the shift supervisor is notified, maintaining a detailed audit history [NL-002#NL-002-S07]. The v2.9.0 specification adds input validation before unlocking the next step, OCR-based photo verification, and write-once PostgreSQL compliance logging [NL-014#NL-014-S03].
